title: ClaimDesk will not deploy on JBoss EAP 8: the legacy security domain
scenario: The first ClaimDesk deployment to JBoss EAP 8 failed: the security CLI script copied from EAP 7.4 errors out and the Jakarta EE 10 WAR will not deploy. A developer blames the WAR; security wants the same LDAP, groups and roles and no secrets in scripts.
task: Explain the CLI failure and the deployment failure from the logs; separate noise from cause
Rewrite the security setup for Elytron with identical user lookup, nested groups and role mapping
Use the existing credential store instead of the vault; keep the WAR unchanged
Map each old login-module option to its Elytron home in ANSWER.md
acceptance: Static dry run clean: EAP 8 subsystems only, references resolve, no vault
dir-context, ldap-realm with role recursion, decoder, mapper, domain, FORM factory, Undertow domain as the WAR names it
Applied as a batch and reloaded
ANSWER.md explains the legacy subsystem removal

practices.label: Week 7 add-on - JBoss EAP 8 security migration
